description: Source file implementing JavaScript bridge object injection and message handling for WebKit browser frames, including functions for encoding/decoding base64 strings, handling exceptions, and managing communication between JavaScript and native code.

methods.name: JSStringToString
methods.description: Converts a JSStringRef to a std::string.

methods.name: JSStringToB64WKString
methods.description: Encodes a JSStringRef to a base64 WKStringRef.

methods.name: B64WKStringToJSString
methods.description: Decodes a base64 WKStringRef to a JSStringRef.

methods.name: LogException
methods.description: Logs JavaScript exceptions to the global trace.

methods.name: OnBridgeQuery
methods.description: Handles bridge query messages from JavaScript.

methods.name: OnCreateBridgeObject
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript bridge object with a message change callback.

methods.name: CallBridge
methods.description: Executes a JavaScript function in the WebKit page context with a payload.

methods.name: InjectJS
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code into the main frame of a WebKit page to set up the bridge.
